people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: I, Yahweh, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.
translations.bsb: I, the LORD, will be their God, and My servant David will be a prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken.
translations.kjv: And I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the LORD have spoken
